verdict.rationale: Anytype's official agents skill says an external agent (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) can run scripts against your data to handle bulk edits, transformations and repetitive tasks. This runs on the localhost API, the headless CLI and the MCP server, so bulk work is possible but depends on agent-written scripts and outside tools rather than a native bulk feature. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints or native multi-select bulk actions, a CSV re-import merge/upsert capability (which a user requested), and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk edits at scale.
